item.title: Everything you need to know ahead of transfer deadline day
item.description: With the winter transfer window closing soon, below we've rounded up everything you need to know ahead of transfer deadline day in the EFL. When does the Winter transfer window close? The transfer window has been open from 1 January 2026 and will be closing at 7pm GMT on Monday, 2 February. The deadline is scheduled for February as January 31 falls on a weekend. Clubs in all leagues will still be able to sign free agents after the February deadline. item.description: A Bristol widower’s story of overcoming adversity is helping football supporters smile this January as part of the EFL’s Scan to Smile initiative.
